text:
The mental element of burglary is the intent, at the moment of unlawful entry into a building, to commit a felony inside; the felony need not be carried out, and intent is usually inferred from conduct and circumstances. In England and Wales the equivalent is Theft Act 1968 s.9(1)(a), which requires entering as a trespasser with intent to steal, inflict grievous bodily harm, or cause criminal damage (s.9(2)). Exact definitions vary by US state and by statute, so the precise wording should be checked for a specific jurisdiction.
